sections.Profile:
"Caravan" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1968. The game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and five rollover buttons.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Native Americans, Original Theme, History
